steps.content: [Bureau Corridor on Alert]

Shrill alarms echo through the Bureau as the pursuit team quickly assembles to investigate the situation. They soon trace Rumina's possible whereabouts by detecting the Mania residue left by the Sinner, though they seem hesitant about their findings.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Chief, this may sound bizarre, but after Sinner Rumina melted in the interrogation room, she's currently...

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Flowing in three different unknown directions within the Bureau.
Flowing... in three directions? You recall the voices you heard while freeing her from the chair. Were those all different... "parts" of Rumina?
[Shackles Effect, Red Flash Only]

The shackles in your palm flicker as you sense the connection between you... Though faint, these "parts" exist like tiny flames pulsing with their own heartbeats, some stronger, others barely perceptible.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Judging from the Mania residue, each "part" of Rumina has an extremely limited survival time and is displaying minimal activity, so it's difficult to detect their exact locations and forms. At this point, we can only confirm they're still somewhere inside the Bureau, making no attempt to leave.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Chief, there's no time to lose. Rumina's melting ability is highly unstable. If we miss the three-hour window when her special power is at its peak, she may never be able to take human form again. And besides...
The staff member hands you the monitoring terminal, which displays surging Mania levels in all other Sinners within the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: During this process, her "parts" will be leaking Mania constantly, which will also affect the other Sinners.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I see. I'll be quick.
Suddenly, something tugs at your pant leg.
You look down. To your surprise, you see "Seon," the candle hand.
It rubs itself nervously, gesturing vigorously on the ground, pointing in various directions.
Coincidentally, the directions match what you're sensing through your shackles. It seems that it is also very worried about Rumina and wants to help you find her.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Chief, should we come with you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No need. Rumina... just needs patience and time. She isn't dangerous.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We'll find her and help her return to her normal form. Let's go.
"Seon" eagerly scurries ahead to lead the way.
(Scene change)

XX/XX 14:18
MBCC
Energy Furnace
"Seon" stops here, unable to approach the iron door heated by flames with its wax body. After a moment of hesitation, it lifts the flame atop its "head" and places its hope in you.
You enter alone. The shackles in your palm vibrate, alerting you that you've found the first "part" of Rumina.
[Red Wax Figure's portrait appears]
It's a small, red wax figurine, shaped exactly like the real Rumina.
But unlike Rumina, it behaves like a tireless moth, throwing itself at the furnace flames again and again.

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Why... can't Rumina get in?! Rumina wants to bathe in the hot spring too!
[Red Flash]
The angry wax figurine backs up, then scrambles forward in a charging run. Its body melts, then regains shape, over and over again.
Stop it! You're hurting yourself!

You cover your mouth and nose, fumbling in the thick smoke and scorching air to find a wet towel to cool it down, but it breaks free from your grasp. It shouts something at you loudly, seemingly oblivious to the danger it is in.

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Rumina wants to bathe in the hot spring! Please help Rumina get in!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "Bathe in the hot spring"?

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Seon is in there! Rumina wants to be with Seon. They just pushed him in! There's still time!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Where... did they push Seon?
You stop in your tracks, a sense of foreboding washing over you.

With gritted teeth, it struggles back up and charges again. The roaring flames knock it backward, partially melting its body in the intense heat. After quickly resolidifying, it rises once more, turning its head to shout at you.

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Seon is in the <color=#fb9259>wax pool</color>!

You suddenly recall that infamous "Midnight Hot Spring Inn" from the legend. It's an abandoned wax factory in Syndicate. If those industrial wax pools weren't completely decommissioned back then... You think of the "hot spring bath" she's been talking about all this time, and feel a chill run down your spine.
The red wax figurine leaps up, begging and screaming at you before recklessly charging toward the flames once more. Its body is already in tatters. It likely won't survive another round of melting.
The shackles instantly appear, interweaving and wrapping protectively around the figurine. Fine tendrils of sensation rush into your mind with the Mania emanating from its body.
[Flashback: Factory Background, Original Scene Reenactment Begins]

Seon was tackled by several men, dark figures engulfing him completely. The legs kicked viciously at his fallen body. He tried to fight back, but his malnourished frame could barely twitch under the brutal assault, leaving him completely defenseless.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: Nngh!! Don't touch my sister! Leave her alone!

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: I'm sorry! I'll pay back the money! Please, just give me a little more time. I'm begging you!

The gang had completely sealed off the wax factory from the inside. They easily broke the lock on the siblings' dilapidated shack. Rumina, clutching a stack of grimy picture books to her chest, was hoisted out by one of the thugs like a chick and dragged across the floor.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: No! Rumina doesn't want to go! Seon!

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Help me, Seon! The bad guys are here!

Nearby, several thugs climbed nimbly onto the platform above the industrial wax pool and yanked down a switch. The abandoned factory let out an agonized roar as the machinery reluctantly groaned to life. Filthy red liquid began to flow into the container.
The gang leader planted his foot on Seon's face. The pressure built in Seon's skull as his ears rang like they were exploding, drowning out the thugs' laughter and jostling.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: I did give you time, and it was up just five minutes ago. You knew the rules of the street when you borrowed the money. So where is it?

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: If you can't repay the whole sum, you should at least have that 500,000 DisCoins I lent you for the medicine ready, right? Huh?

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: Alright, I see. You haven't got a penny left on you, you filth. See, we're very accommodating. I heard there's a new trend over in Eastside...
With a casual wave of his hand, surging red liquid instantly filled the entire pool.

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: It's called a "living lantern." Each one fetches a fortune! So, I've given you the choices. Now is the time to make it.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: No, no... Please, just give me a few more days! My sister needs her medicine! Please, I beg you, just a few more days!!

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: You just won't ******* listen when I'm being nice, huh?! Throw him in!
The thugs below swarmed forward, pinning Seon down forcefully. They twisted his body into an unnatural position, bound him, then took him up to the platform.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Seon... Seon! Where are you going? Don't leave Rumina alone! Take Rumina with...

Hearing his sister's screams, Seon stopped struggling. His breathing grew heavy, and though his eyes were bloodshot, he forced a strained smile for Rumina, desperately trying to comfort his frightened sister.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: Rumina, don't be afraid. I'm... I'm only taking a hot spring bath. They're not hurting me. Don't be afraid... Just... just close your eyes.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: After I'm done with the hot spring bath... when you open your eyes, you will see a wax figure of me. You've always liked those, haven't you?

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Wax... figure?

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: Yes, don't be afraid, Rumina... Don't be afraid... Be a good girl and close your eyes... Sing that song from the picture book for me. I... want to hear it.
(Scene change)

With her eyes closed, Rumina couldn't see Seon's bloodied face as his frail body swayed atop the platform. She couldn't see if he was pushed down by many pairs of hands, or if he stepped forward himself. She must listen to Seon. She couldn't look.
As her trembling voice singing the nursery rhyme filled the air, he plummeted again and again like a drifting candle wick, turning into a wax figure.

The wax figurines Seon brought home never took this long to make. Rumina's heart raced in panic, and she couldn't help but crack open her eyes. When she realized what she was seeing, her vision suddenly fractured into overlapping images. There were many people and voices, but they all seemed distant, as if her soul drifted away as her body crumpled to the ground.
Flames licked at that face as the abandoned factory wailed painfully in the wind.
In her vision, the burning flames seemed trapped in wax, distant as if they were billions of light years away.

steps.speaker: Seon
steps.content: Rumina, I'm sorry...

He was her only family, her beloved brother, and through tears of blood, she desperately tried to focus on his face. But no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't make out the features she had known so dearly since childhood.
(End of Flashback)
You stand in its path as the shackles slowly fade away. It lunges into your arms, crashing against your chest so hard it hurts, but you simply hold it gently, refusing to let go.

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Rumina is so useless. Rumina can't be with Seon... It's all Rumina's fault for being sick!

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: But Rumina hates those bad guys even more! They made Seon go into the hot spring bath! They destroyed Rumina's safe house!
The little red figure struggles desperately in your arms, pounding and thrashing until your shirt is covered with melted wax tears... Eventually, it grows quiet.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You wanted to save your brother, but you were too young to fight against those bad guys. That wasn't your fault.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're suffering too, Rumina, but if Seon were still here... he would want you to be happy and safe. Most importantly, he would want to see you grow up healthy.
It lifts its head, sobbing. You comfort it gently, speaking in a soft voice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But now you're so heartbroken that you've melted into pieces, and you risk never being able to piece yourself back together as a person again...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So we need to hurry... Otherwise, the real Rumina won't be able to take human form again. If that happened, Seon wouldn't be able to see you grow up, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you are a part of Rumina, would you trust me the way she does?
It lowers its head and buries itself silently in your arms. Soon after, the burning light of the candle wick gradually stabilizes, pulsing steadily.

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Rumina's safe house is gone... Rumina has only you to depend on now...

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Please take Rumina with you.
It clings tightly to your arm. You pick up the red wax figurine, its breathing growing heavier, and leave the area, hurrying toward your next destination.
(Scene change)

XX/XX 15:34
MBCC
Cold Store
"Seon" hops onto the door handle and pushes hard against the cold store door. Bits of frost break off and scatter across the floor, nearly extinguishing the flame atop its head.
Learning from your previous experience, you leave "Seon" at the entrance and push through the door alone, following the faint signal from the shackles to locate your target.
A soft rustling comes from behind a row of frozen food shelves.
[White Wax Figure's portrait appears]

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: ...I'm hungry. I'll eat a little.
You barely make out a tiny "Rumina" amid the white frost. It looks up at you vacantly, its eyes meeting yours.
It hesitates for a moment, then shakily holds out a piece of frost to you.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: Seon hasn't brought food back yet. Rumina will just fill her tummy with these little bits from the wall. It's fine... It's quite tasty once you get used to it...

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: It tastes good... Try some.
It reaches toward your mouth, but perhaps because the movement is too sudden and vigorous, fine cracks appear across its small wax body, threatening to break apart.
You quickly accept the frost it's offering and use the warmth of your palm to stop the cracks from spreading.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Careful, you'll break apart like that...
The frost melts into water on the little wax figure's face, making it look even more innocent than before.
It looks down at the cracks on its body, suddenly overcome with emotion. It touches its own face, as if searching for something, then begins to cry.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: The cracks... Do you like them?

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: But... they don't like them. They want a perfect wax figure...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Who are "they"?

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: Well...
(Flashback)
Rumina lay on the ground, eyes wide open, staring at the pool of molten wax. She bit down hard on her lip, appearing as lifeless as a tattered rag doll discarded in a random trash bin in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Boss, we've got a problem. At first the buyer was willing to pay a lot for this "living lantern," but they backed out after finding out it was our model. So we disposed of it, but now they want it again. What do we do?

steps.speaker: Gang Leader
steps.content: So their taste has changed again? What is it this time? Something freshly dug out of the Rust? Or...

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Boss, hey... haven't we already got one here?
[Sound of something heavy being thrown into an industrial vat]
[Black Screen Transition]

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: The bad guys thought they messed up. They thought Rumina melted away completely in the wax pool...

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: ...When Rumina woke up, there wasn't a single person around.
[Cracking sound effect]
After a long time, something stirred in the solidified wax pool. A crack formed in the surface, resembling a scab on red skin.
[Portrait: Rumina's cracked face fades to black]
The crack widened gradually until the object inside was fully revealed. A gray figure completely covered in wax crawled out arduously.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: Rumina couldn't breathe... couldn't even walk...

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: In the end... Rumina found a piece of sheet metal... to scrape off the wax from her skin... just to be able to breathe...
Crack... Crack... Crack...
[Portrait: Rumina's cracked face is revealed]

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: That's why Rumina has these ugly cracks on her face. When the wind blows over them, it feels so cold...
(End of Flashback)
It speaks slowly, its body shivering slightly, perhaps due to the cold store's low temperature, or the pain from her past.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: But it feels like Rumina's heart has cracks too, like a piece is missing... Seon died, and Rumina died too... so why did Rumina come back to life...
It sniffles, asking you with childlike innocence, the question seemingly directed at itself as well.
With these collected fragments, you can now piece together the entire incident of Rumina's awakening. Your heart feels constricted, causing you raw, visceral pain.
You take off your coat and wrap it tightly around the trembling figure. The still-warmed lining chases away the chill, and it nestles comfortably into the garment.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: After that... you stayed in that wax factory, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even though it was a dilapidated, abandoned place... unbearably cold and full of painful memories...

Hearing this, the white wax figurine looks around, as if seeing that old wax factory right before its eyes. Then, surprisingly, it shakes its head with a look of happiness on its face, even giggling a little.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: No, that's not true. Seon's flames... lit up this place, so it's very safe here. The bad guys can never come in again. This place is warm, just like Seon.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: The only difference is that... it was Seon who guarded our safe house before, but now Rumina has to guard it by herself.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: If I do as Seon and the picture books said, this place will be safe. Rumina will fight the bad guys herself and guard the safe house.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: You're someone Rumina trusts. Please tell me, is Rumina doing the right thing? Am I doing as good a job as Seon did?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rumina...
Unusually for you, you don't respond to it. You're tempted to correct it.

Its childlike logic is completely irrational, and hastily affirming or denying it could have a profound, unknown effect. You decide that once Rumina recovers, you'll have a detailed cognitive counseling plan ready for her.

Right now, though, it seems very attached to this "safe house." How can you convince it to leave? You gently tighten the coat draped over its shoulders, tucking it more securely to keep it warm, while carefully considering what to say next.

Just as you're about to speak, it gently touches its face, discovering that the cracks have been melted and smoothed by your body heat. The next moment, it embraces your hand like a happy little bird.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: Your embrace is so warm, just like... just like...

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: Just like the days when Rumina was still protected. Rumina likes it.

options: Seize the chance to take it away now

choices.text: Seize the chance to take it away now

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then shall we leave this place and go somewhere even warmer and safer?
It nestles in the coat and nods at you childishly.

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: Sure.
[Scene transition: Sinner's Cell]
Time is running out.
You can sense that the last "part" is somewhere in the Sinner cell block. Following your intuition, the first place you think of is Rumina's own room.
[Flashback to the interrogation room]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you don't feel safe here, I can take you back to your room now. You have your favorite picture books there, and stories about Seon...
(End of Flashback)
The two "parts" of Rumina in your arms are now fast asleep. Only twenty minutes left...
[Gray Wax Figure's portrait appears]
You finally discover the silhouette of the last "part" in the corner of Rumina's room.

XX/XX 16:51
MBCC
Rumina's Room
You heave a sigh of relief and check the time... Thank goodness, you made it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rumina, it's me.

"Seon" climbs onto the desk, illuminating a familiar small figure in the shadowy space. The little gray "Rumina" sits quietly in the furthest corner of the room, surrounded by scattered picture books created by Rumina herself in her free time.
It barely reacts to your arrival, merely lifting its face slightly before lowering it back down.
The door clicks shut behind you. You crouch down to look at the tiny figure huddled in the corner.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I know... you're just like the two other parts. You want to be found and seen by the person who matters most to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You told me once that you liked being with me, so I took it upon myself to come find you. I hope I haven't disappointed you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thankfully, I'm not too late. Sorry to have kept you waiting...
You extend your hand, reaching into the darkness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Shall we bring Rumina back together?
It stares at your palm for a few seconds, then averts its gaze. Hugging its knees, it retreats deeper into the darkness.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: The wax factory was burned to the ground. There will never be another safe place again.

options: Ask about the fire at the wax factory

choices.text: Ask about the fire at the wax factory

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What exactly happened back then?
[Flashback to an interrogation room segment]

"It's on fire! That 'hot spring inn' is burning down! Cough, cough... Someone call the fire department! Most of these are abandoned buildings here... Hurry up! Hey, stop filming and help!" "...She's gone. Did you all see that? She... she just disappeared?!"
(End of Flashback)
Wait. If she really did suddenly vanish at that moment... then perhaps someone else was there at the scene. Someone... you know.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Was Irrheia there when the wax factory burned down?

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: ...Okay.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: Irrheia... she was fascinated by the "Midnight Hot Spring Inn" urban legend. After she tracked it down, she became Rumina's very first guest.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: It was the first time Rumina used the power, so Rumina couldn't do it very well... That's why the place burned down.
It continues to speak in a flat, emotionless tone, confessing to its crime. You don't interrupt, sensing there's more it wants to tell you.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: The safe house Seon once gave to Rumina was tiny... Though there were only picture books inside, and Rumina couldn't go out to see the world, Rumina felt so warm and safe there... But it was destroyed, and that broke Rumina's heart...

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: Irrheia promised Rumina a new safe house where Rumina could stay protected... There were all kinds of things from the picture books there, strange new worlds Rumina had never seen before. Something always felt missing, though, and in the end, that place was gone too.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: Rumina wanted to follow you, but after coming to this house, you never came looking for Rumina. Rumina had no choice but to find a safe place on her own...

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: But there are many things Rumina doesn't understand. People and things Rumina doesn't know. Rumina keeps getting hurt and hurting others too... Rumina doesn't want to be like this, but Rumina doesn't know what to do.
The flame atop "Seon" gradually dims as the gray wax figure begins to blend into the darkness.
You sense its grievance, indignation, and anxiety directed toward you, all pouring uncontrollably from this part of Rumina.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: Seon and the safe house are gone... Rumina will never find them again in this world...

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: There will never be another safe place...
It trembles faintly, like its heart has shattered into dust.

This part of Rumina seems to come from the deepest part of her heart. Unlike the previous parts that embodied her anger and desire for vengeance over her brother's death, or her despair and suffering about her own trauma, this part before you contains something so overwhelming it fills the entire room with...
Helplessness.
Time is running short, but still, you begin patiently.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is the MBCC. Everyone here is a "Sinner" just like you. I'm Chief of the Bureau, and I look after all the Sinners detained here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No one will dare bully you. I won't allow it to happen. And you won't need to fight "bad guys" anymore to defend yourself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I will protect you, Rumina. This place is safe.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You can trust me. I mean every word I say.
The flame flickers for a moment, and you hear a clearer voice.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: Did you say... you would protect me? Is this place really safe?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes, I will protect you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As long as I'm here, you can depend on me.
Your voice is like candlelight, illuminating the entire room, blanketing the surging helplessness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Rumina, if you don't feel safe anywhere...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then let me be your "safe house."
The air grows still, yet darkness continues to linger.
The glowing wick suddenly crackles, and the flame begins to burn more brightly.
The candlelight is reflected in its grayish eyes.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: Really? Do you... truly mean that?

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: Are you truly willing to do that?
Drip, drip.
Gray liquid spreads across the floor, emitting a strange odor.

The viscous liquid creeps up your pant leg, climbing higher and higher... The candlelight flickers as darkness envelops you. A sudden gust of wind disrupts your vision, and in the next instant, it stands right before you.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: You'll be Rumina's "safe house"... You'll stay with Rumina forever, protecting Rumina...

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: You'll never ever leave Rumina, right?
Its quivering voice grows increasingly zealous as it finally lifts its grotesque, melted face with a smile and opens its arms toward you.
Your gaze sharpens as you look down to discover countless strands of wax already swarming before you, binding the two of you together stickily.

The wax clings onto you relentlessly, frantically trying to burrow into your vulnerable body like a living creature. Every strand carries the deepest longing to imprison you, refusing to let you leave.
You react quickly.
The moment you unleash the shackles, all fragments shatter and scatter into burning droplets of candle wax, spinning and dancing like stars in the viscous darkness.
These wax droplets distort the space around them, then are penetrated and connected one by one.
The darkness finally ceases surging as, swiftly and decisively, yet gently and powerfully, the shackles piece all the wax droplets back together.
[Rumina herself appears]
In the darkness, Rumina has finally returned to her original form, sitting properly atop the picture books.
She looks innocent and bewildered, clearly unaware of what happened after she melted. She stares at you in a daze, yet her eyes reveal a deeper attachment than before.
The fragments you witnessed and comforted have ultimately become part of her again, forging an utterly unique bond between you.
Unable to clearly name the emotions within her, she takes a deep breath before hesitantly reaching out a trembling hand toward you.
You instinctively step back, but immediately realize your mistake when you hear the sobs in her voice.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Chief... would you please hold Rumina's hand?

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina is scared. Please don't abandon Rumina...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: I beg you...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't be afraid. I promised to protect you, and I will keep my promise.
You step forward and take Rumina's hand.
She smiles with joy but doesn't let go, gently touching your face with her other hand, carefully tracing the shapes of your eyes, eyebrows, and the bridge of your nose.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina will remember now... So this is what that blurry face looks like.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: You're the one who will love and protect me forever. The red spikes have pierced through us both. We'll... never be apart again.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: How wonderful... This is what Rumina wants most of all...
[Quick Flash]

steps.speaker: Red Wax Figurine
steps.content: Rumina's safe house is gone... Rumina has only you to depend on now...

steps.speaker: White Wax Figurine
steps.content: Your embrace is so warm, just like the days when Rumina was still protected. Rumina likes it.

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: You'll be Rumina's "safe house"... You'll stay with Rumina forever, protecting Rumina...

steps.speaker: Gray Wax Figurine
steps.content: You'll never ever leave Rumina, right?
[End of Quick Flash]
In the next instant, space distorts and book pages flutter as the picture book beneath her emits an eerie glow, revealing a long-hidden entrance.
You immediately feel a surge of powerful, obsessive energy dragging you toward that opening into the picture book. Blinding light instantly illuminates the entire Sinner cell block.
The book pages drift gently to the floor as Rumina's room now stands completely empty.
You sense a hint of danger and don't take her hand.
From then on, Rumina refuses to let you come near her and never again takes a single step outside her cell.
